text: 【央行：9月7日将开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作】2026年9月7日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月（89天），到期日为2026年12月5日。
text_en: PBOC: To conduct 500 billion yuan outright reverse repo operations on September 7 — On September 7, 2026, the People's Bank of China will conduct a 500 billion yuan outright reverse repo operation via fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price auction, with a term of 3 months (89 days) and maturity on December 5, 2026.
